data.name: Sharvaarth
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvaarth is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which is another name for Lord Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, music, arts, wisdom, and prosperity. The name Sharvaarth signifies the grace and blessings of Saraswati.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharvam' which means 'related to Shiva'. The suffix 'arth' means 'path'. Hence, Sharvaarth means 'The one who has the path leading to Shiva'.
